name: wgrender-hx
description: Haxe bindings for wgrender: one API over hxcpp (native and wasm) and JS, where wgrender is a wasm host and the game a guest module. Run `haxelib run wgrender-hx setup` once to build the wgrender it vendors.
releasenote: First cut: the slice of wgrender the simple example uses, on both targets.
